description: This file implements virtual filesystem (VFS) functions for the libwebsockets library, including file position retrieval, length, modification time, seek operations, and platform-specific file operations selection.

methods.name: void lws_set_fops(struct lws_context * context,const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops)
methods.description: Sets the file operations structure for the context.

methods.name: lws_filepos_t lws_vfs_tell(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd)
methods.description: Returns the current position within the file.

methods.name: lws_filepos_t lws_vfs_get_length(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd)
methods.description: Returns the total length of the file.

methods.name: uint32_t lws_vfs_get_mod_time(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd)
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of the file.

methods.name: lws_fileofs_t lws_vfs_file_seek_set(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd,lws_fileofs_t offset)
methods.description: Seeks to an absolute position within the file.

methods.name: lws_fileofs_t lws_vfs_file_seek_end(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd,lws_fileofs_t offset)
methods.description: Seeks relative to the end of the file.

methods.name: const struct lws_plat_file_ops * lws_vfs_select_fops(const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops,const char * vfs_path,const char ** vpath)
methods.description: Selects appropriate platform-specific file operations based on the VFS path.

methods.name: lws_fop_fd_t LWS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT lws_vfs_file_open(const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops,const char * vfs_path,lws_fop_flags_t * flags)
methods.description: Opens a file within the virtual filesystem.

methods.name: struct:lws_plat_file_ops * lws_get_fops(struct lws_context * context)
methods.description: Retrieves the current file operations structure from the context.

ctags.name: lws_vfs_file_open
ctags.signature: (const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops,const char * vfs_path,lws_fop_flags_t * flags)

ctags.name: lws_vfs_select_fops
ctags.signature: (const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops,const char * vfs_path,const char ** vpath)
